maya: quick heads-up: tomorrow 09:00 PT we9ll bind vault/staging transit to the HSM KMS key. Goal: retire softwrap key, add IAM condition (vault-only) and shrink blast radius. Need RBAC preflight + audit buffer plan.

sam: noted. I9ll run `kubectl auth can-i` for vault agents and prepare terraform snippet for conditional binding.

leo: partner-sync must not get direct key access. propose short-lived envelope tokens via constrained Vault role instead.

ana: Fluentd had intermittent drops in staging. I9ll provision S3 buffer for audit events during the window and record SHA256 checksums.

sec-bot: KMS health: OK. Created incident INC-2026-0615-kms-hsm-bind.

maya: runbook: 1) apply conditional IAM binding 2) rotate keyVersion 3) update Vault transit 4) smoke unseal 5) verify audit events (encrypt/decrypt with principal). rollback: revert binding + transit config.

sam: preflight checks: `kubectl auth can-i update secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:platform:vault-agent-stg` => yes. I9ll post the terraform in PR.

leo: adding OPA rule to deny kms roles to infra-ci service accounts unless approved. Will open PR with tests.

ana: buffer ready. will upload post-window and attach checksums to incident.

maya: starting canary at 09:00 PT. ping here with any missing audit rows or malformed events. thanks all :thumbsup:
